test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’

Which of the following options means ‘Q is the wife of S'?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given:

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’

 
 

 Symbol
 Relation
 
 

 @
 Son
 
 

 &
 Mother
 
 

 #
 Daughter
 
 

Let's check each option one by one:-

1) P @ Q & R # S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ae5d3a76b5d62d19606f3d36fd530dbc590d69a1d59b008624160b54e7058e8.png] 

Yes, Q is the wife of S in above diagram.

2) R @ S @ Q # P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c538821fe4907a5ebc87f3d2684594c15be932711c05c723ba0ee2d1b782778.png] 

 

No, Q is the mother of S. So it is false.

3) R @ S & Q # P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/499ec47ddc50030da5c737d46b9d5190078f348bc762fe3eec01ab4c7a6c2df0.png] 

No, Q is the daughter of S. So it is false.

4) P # Q @ R # S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/209b77487ca2e0046011ba654910d32e9aa984f323ae502372f09c1287928bef.png] 

No, Q is the grand-daughter of S. So it is false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
